Floral Bouquet Calendar (Wood) – Eco-Friendly Table Décor with 12 Monthly Cards & Wooden Easel Stand

The Floral Bouquet Calendar (Wood) is a beautifully designed, eco-friendly desk accessory crafted for homes, offices, workstations, and gifting. Featuring 12 monthly cards cut in a unique flower bunch shape (3.5″×7″), this wooden calendar adds a refreshing aesthetic to any space. Each card displays a creatively illustrated floral theme, making it a perfect blend of nature-inspired design and practical functionality. The calendar comes with a sturdy mini wooden easel stand (6″) that ensures stability and a premium handcrafted look.

This eco-friendly calendar is ideal for users who prefer sustainable products and minimalist décor. With a compact structure and elegant floral patterns, the Floral Bouquet Calendar (Wood) enhances desks, reception areas, study tables, bedside counters, and work-from-home setups. It also serves as a thoughtful option for corporate gifts, New Year gifts, employee welcome kits, and festival gifting. Designed using premium wooden materials, the calendar offers durability and long-term usability without compromising aesthetic appeal.

If you are looking for a desk calendar that stands out with handmade charm and sustainability, this floral wooden calendar is the perfect match. The 12 monthly cards feature vibrant flower bunch silhouettes, giving each month a fresh visual identity. Its compact size makes it suitable for all table types, from modern offices to classic study rooms. The polished wooden easel adds a touch of natural warmth, complementing eco-friendly interior setups effortlessly.

The is also designed for customers searching for aesthetic office table calendars or elegant home décor calendars. Its unique floral design creates a soothing everyday viewing experience, reducing visual clutter often caused by conventional calendars. With high usability and an artistic finish, this product is ideal for content creators, designers, teachers, managers, and anyone looking for creative décor that also supports productivity.

Why Choose?

Sustainability, beauty, and practicality come together in this premium product. Each monthly card is printed on high-quality, eco-conscious material, making the suitable for customers who prefer environmentally responsible products. The wooden easel stand ensures that the cards remain upright throughout the year, without bending or losing form. Its handcrafted look enhances the overall charm, making it a standout for personal use and professional gifting.

Key Features

  • Eco-Friendly Wooden Construction – Designed using sustainable wood for long-term use.
  • 12 Monthly Floral Cards (3.5″×7″) – Each card features a flower bunch shape with vibrant monthly artwork.
  • Sturdy Mini Wooden Easel Stand (6″) – Ensures strong balance and an elegant display.
  • Compact & Aesthetic Design – Perfect for office desks, reception counters, study spaces, and home décor.
  • Nature-Inspired Floral Theme – Brings freshness and liveliness to daily work environments.
  • Ideal for Corporate Gifts – A premium-quality, eco-friendly gift option for clients, employees, and events.
  • Perfect for New Year & Festive Gifting – A thoughtful handmade gift item with year-round usability.
  • Lightweight & Durable – Easy to handle, store, and reuse for decorative purposes.

Best Use Cases

The Floral Bouquet Calendar (Wood) is perfect for those who value sustainability, elegance, and functional design. It is widely used as:

  • Desk calendar for office professionals
  • Work-from-home productivity accessory
  • Eco-friendly corporate gifting solution
  • Employee joining kit add-on
  • Creative décor element for home and office
  • New Year, festive, or appreciation gift

Make every month special with this beautifully crafted Its  materials, floral artistry, and premium wooden support make it a perfect choice for décor lovers, professionals, and gifting needs. Add a calming, nature-inspired touch to your workspace and enjoy a fresh floral experience throughout the year.
